description: This file defines types, functions, and classes related to ARIA (Accessible Rich Internet Applications) node representation, comparison, and YAML parsing for accessibility snapshot processing within the Playwright project.

classes.name: KeyParser
classes.description: Parser class for interpreting ARIA role and attribute keys from YAML input.

classes.name: ParserError
classes.description: Custom error class for reporting parsing errors with position info.

methods.name: ariaNodesEqual
methods.description: Compares two AriaNode objects for equality based on role, name, properties, and cursor.

methods.name: hasPointerCursor
methods.description: Checks if an AriaNode's box has a cursor style of 'pointer'.

methods.name: parseAriaSnapshotUnsafe
methods.description: Parses an ARIA snapshot YAML text into an AriaTemplateNode, throwing on errors.

methods.name: parseAriaSnapshot
methods.description: Parses an ARIA snapshot YAML text into an object with fragment and errors.

methods.name: findNewNode
methods.description: Finds a new AriaNode in 'to' that is not present in 'from', based on role and name heuristics.
